_comment: Demo storyboard, replayed by record-demo.mjs. REAL STACK: connects to the live Komga test server
(pnpm komga:up) through the app's own Add-a-source UI and reads a real EPUB. No fixture seed.
PROGRESS IS DEMONSTRATED, NOT ASSERTED. Komga's readProgress starts null after a library rescan, so
the demo WRITES progress (page turns), shows it on the Library card, RELOADS the whole app, and
reopens the book to prove the position survived. That is a stronger claim than a pre-seeded number,
and it cannot silently lie if the server state changes.
Do NOT hardcode the source id: it is a fresh UUID on every connect. Select books by title text.
The recorder uses a clean browser context, so no source is persisted -> the add-source flow always runs.
The read button says 'Start reading' with no progress and 'Continue reading' with progress: match on
the substring 'reading' so both work.
Step keys: caption(+ms) | goto | click | hover | type(+value,delayMs) | fill(+value) |
press(+times,betweenMs) | waitFor(+timeout) | wait | scroll | resize | pauseMs | frame.
BEFORE EACH TAKE, reset the demo book's server-side progress or the "Nothing read yet" caption lies:
curl -X DELETE -u reader@edda.test:edda-reader-pw http://localhost:25600/api/v1/books/0QV3QQ301F9W9/read-progress
GOTCHA: the Scroll->Paged toggle rebuilds the navigator. Page-turn clicks fired within ~1.5s of
that rebuild are SWALLOWED (3 clicks advanced only 1 page). Hence the settle wait before turning,
and 5 turns so the resumed spread is visibly past the opening spread.
HONESTY NOTE: progress is stored per PAGE, and the paged view resumes to the SPREAD containing that
page — leave at p.3-4, reopen at p.2-3. The caption says "the position the server stored", not
"exactly where you left off", because the frame would contradict the stronger claim.

steps.caption: Edda — a self-hosted library e-reader. Offline-first PWA.
Connect a real server. Edda probes it and detects the rest.
Reachable · Komga server · adapter ready — with its capabilities.
Credentials stay on this device.
The library, served from Komga — real books, real cover art.
Book detail. Nothing read yet.
A real EPUB. Book content renders on a separate origin (ADR-013).
Reading themes live behind the “Aa” control.
Sepia.
Dark — the chrome follows the page, not just the text.
Parchment.
Typeface too — Newsreader to Literata.
And the page model: paged spread, or continuous scroll.

steps.note: navigator settles after the Scroll->Paged rebuild; early clicks are swallowed
let the outbox drain to Komga before we navigate away

steps.caption: Turn the page. Each position is written back to the server.
Back to the library.
“Keep reading” now shows where we stopped.
Reload the whole app — progress is not a page variable.
Still there, after a full restart.
And it reopens at the position the server stored.
Connectors and formats are plugins, installed on demand.
PDF support installed — a lazy chunk, not a download.
Edda — quiet, precise, self-hosted.
